difficulty_reason: The lemma is the degree inequality powering the tail/bridge analysis of the chapter (statement lines 6032-6040). The proof (lines 6042-6077) is complete: the restriction-sequence degree identity over the field of definition, the divisibility-driven exclusion leaving the single rational point with vanishing H^1, and the two-case conclusion (irreducible gives a tail; reducible drops to a negative-degree component and repeats). Every step is present with no omissions. H2: the same systematic machinery as the companion ampleness lemma, correctly ordered.
